name: dev
description: Working principles for code changes via the ub-mode skill (tracked as a pinned git submodule of github.com/unclebob/ub-mode): every change follows First Make it Work, then Then Make it Right, then Practice. The ub-setup command installs the external analysis tools (crapper, dryer, mutator) used by the Then Make it Right sections. Use when the user runs /ub-mode or asks for the reduced principles.
